Chosen Forge: a map editor for Blood
====================================

Make and edit Blood levels in the manner of UltimateDoomBuilder: Blood's .MAP files (NBlood and Blood load them) and
Chosen's .MAPX.

Run ChosenForge.exe. It finds your Blood install for the tile pictures (Edit > Preferences sets the folder; without
one it still edits, showing tile numbers). Tools > Test Map (F9) plays the map in Chosen: unpack the game's zip beside
this folder (Forge finds Chosen.exe in any folder next to its own) or into this one.

Keys: V vertices, L walls, S sectors, T sprites, D draw lines, Ctrl+Shift+D draw rectangle; right-click for an item's
properties; Insert / Delete; Ctrl+Z undo. Settings: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Chosen Forge\forge.cfg.

Chosen is an unofficial fan project, free software under the GPL v2, with Ken Silverman's Build licence for
the game's ports of Build's engine code (LICENSE.md, licenses\). Its source is public; Blood's files are not part of it.
